description: This PHP source file defines the 'CorporateBrandingController' class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically responsible for handling the corporate branding component in the HR management application. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and provides a preRender method that prepares a Vue component with various properties related to corporate branding such as allowed image types, aspect ratios, and maximum file size.

classes.name: CorporateBrandingController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing Vue component for corporate branding configurations, including allowed images, aspect ratios, and file size limits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component 'corporate-branding' with properties related to image types, aspect ratios, tolerance, and file size, prior to rendering.
